name: ordinary-day
about: Two campaigns with leads, a month's spend and two mature cohorts beside a young one.

output.headline: On November 3, 2026, 2 campaigns ran and together brought in 7 leads at a cost per lead of $40.61 on $284.25 in spend.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet drove 6 of the day's 7 leads with a cost per lead of $30.75, a click rate of 1.5%, and $184.50 in spend across 9,120 impressions and 141 clicks.
Dedicated night runs returned 1 lead at a cost per lead of $99.75 — the highest of the 2 campaigns — on $99.75 in spend, 5,480 impressions, and 62 clicks at a 1.1% click rate.
Month-to-date in November 2026, Meta has taken $612.30 in spend with 28 days left in the month.
The 2026-09-21 cohort (38 leads) is mature: 33 were contacted (86.8%), 17 converted to applicants (44.7%), 10 applied (26.3%), 4 were hired (10.5%), and 8 were lost after conversion (21.1%).
The 2026-09-28 cohort (40 leads) is mature: 36 were contacted (90.0%), 20 converted to applicants (50.0%), 12 applied (30.0%), 5 were hired (12.5%), and 9 were lost after conversion (22.5%).
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 12 leads — 9 contacted, 3 converted to applicants, 1 applied, and 1 lost after conversion — but it is too young to judge its rates.
